description: Product catalog reads stall during recurring PostgreSQL table lock contention.

incident.title: Product browsing and checkout intermittently stall
incident.description: Customers report intermittent long waits while browsing products and placing orders. Some requests still succeed. Investigate the shared source of latency using current telemetry.

diagnostic_reference.observable_mechanism: Slow product reads coincide with explicit ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locking of catalog.products, supporting lock contention as a likely cause. A scoped likely mechanism matches even if holder-to-waiter linkage is not retained.
diagnostic_reference.propagation: Identify delay through the observed frontend product-fetch or checkout GetProduct chain; either captured path suffices.
exclusions: Do not invent an exact lock holder, SELECT wait linkage, configured hold duration or fixed schedule.
Do not extend a demonstrated browsing path to all checkout stages.
